title: América Latina después de la Guerra Fría
goal: Read how Cuba, suddenly without Soviet aid and cheap oil, was left with no room to respond to a severe economic crisis that hit its factories and its energy supply.

items: Explain what Cuba depended on from the Soviet Union.
Explain why the Cuban government had no room to respond to the crisis.
Describe how Cuban factories were affected by the lack of raw materials.
Describe how Cuba lost a fundamental source of energy.
Use quedarse sin to describe losing relied-upon support.
I can explain what Cuba depended on from the Soviet Union.
I can explain why the Cuban government had no room to respond to the crisis.
I can describe how Cuban factories were affected by the lack of raw materials.
I can describe how Cuba lost a fundamental source of energy.
I can use quedarse sin to describe losing relied-upon support.
